properties.name: pqs:context

OpenVPN's CBC path applies the separate --auth HMAC (encrypt-then-MAC) by construction, so the 'malleable unless a MAC is applied separately' concern is mitigated in the shipped path rather than being a bare-CBC bug; C rating reflects its legacy/compat role. Changeable here.

properties.value: Poly1305 appears here only as the authenticator half of the ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD data-channel cipher: crypto_openssl.c:281 is the OpenVPN↔OpenSSL cipher-name row, :733/:795/:915 are NID_chacha20_poly1305 special-casing in the EVP backend (AEAD tag handling), and the remaining sites are unit tests of that same cipher. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SIGNATURE support via the management interface and xkey provider (PKCS#11 tokens, external keys) for the TLS control channel. Quantum-unsafe signature scheme — the right migration is ML-DSA-65/SLH-DSA, not the ML-KEM-768 target the 'encryption' label implies; reclassify as signature, not PKE.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Generates secp256k1 key material and CSRs to exercise OpenVPN's OpenSSL-backed arbitrary-curve support in tests and sample configs. secp256k1 (ECDSA/ECDH class) is Shor-vulnerable; test/sample material.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Raw RSA private key installed into the TLS control-channel context (the --key option path, distinct from cert-embedded keys). Role is certificate-authenticated TLS: RSA is Shor-broken both as static key transport and as the signature algorithm; ML-DSA is the signature-role migration.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real: xkey_provider.c's OpenSSL-provider dispatch table registers the "RSA-PSS" key type so RSA-PSS sign/verify is routed through OpenVPN's external-key interface (PKCS#11 / management-channel keys). Quantum-vulnerable signature scheme, shipped in the binary, exercised whenever an external RSA-PSS key signs; migration target ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RFC 7919 ffdhe2048 group shipped as the sample --dh parameter file for the TLS control channel. Finite-field DH: Shor-broken, and 2048 bits is only ~112-bit classical security — kept for pre-ECDHE compatibility. Changeable here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 (secp256r1) is a supported TLS key-agreement group in this product: the mbed TLS group-table row (ssl_mbedtls.c:347) plus the OpenSSL-side IANA-name→prime256v1 translation (ssl_openssl.c:538/540) that accepts secp256r1 in --tls-groups/--ecdh-curve. Classical curve, quantum-vulnerable, user-selectable.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: OpenVPN's mbedTLS backend ships X25519 as a selectable TLS group (--tls-groups/--show-groups surface via ecp_curve_info_table, ssl_mbedtls.c:344-403); the OpenSSL backend negotiates it by library default. Classical key agreement, retroactively breakable — harvest-now-decrypt-later; PQ fix is the X25519MLKEM768 hybrid once the linked library offers it.

properties.value: The object's posture claim is real, though the cited sites are weak: ssl_openssl.c:207 is the openssl_tls_version() constant-mapping function and :2555 caps the --show-tls diagnostic listing at TLS 1.2. properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Default data-channel AEAD for OpenVPN 2.5+ (AES-256-GCM preferred; graded at the AES-128 floor because AES-128-GCM is also in the default list). Strongest symmetric posture in this tree short of PQ key exchange.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real: AES-128-GCM is part of OpenVPN's default --data-ciphers (ssl_ncp.c:229 returns "AES-256-GCM:AES-128-GCM" when ChaCha20-Poly1305 is unavailable; full default adds it), supported across all backends including DCO kernel data paths (dco_linux.c:1380, dco_freebsd.c:928, dco_win.c:995) and the mbed TLS PSA registration table (crypto_mbedtls.c:93/98/103: AES-128-GCM/CBC/CTR). 128-bit key is quantum-safe (Grover) but below CNSA 2.0 preference for symmetric keys.

properties.name: pqs:context

Not used by any OpenVPN default. Quantum-resistant (Grover only).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Real security use: x509_get_sha256_fingerprint (ssl_verify_openssl.c:369-375) computes the SHA-256 certificate fingerprint used for --verify-hash SHA-256 pinning (compared constant-time in verify_cert_hash, ssl_verify.c:706) and for --peer-fingerprint / cert-hash-set comparison (ssl_verify.c:229-244) on renegotiation. Quantum-resistant; good posture.
